eli-docs: Opening a compact PR to clean up the Error Reference (429s, timeouts, context limits). Goal: consolidate examples, replace one stale embedding link, and add tiny SDK retry snippets (Py + Go). Need snippet reviews.
sam-ops: I can review Go. Do we need separate notes for Dedicated vs Hosted throttling?
eli-docs: Yes please add one-line note: 'throttling thresholds vary by deployment mode; see capacity table.' Keep it short.
nina: Found an old curl route and a gist link to replace. I'll paste corrected links in PR.
maria: For timeouts, let's include a minimal retry: 3 attempts, exponential backoff + jitter.
eli-docs: Draft Py snippet to include:
```
for attempt in range(3):
  try:
    resp = session.post(url, json=payload, timeout=5)
    resp.raise_for_status(); break
  except requests.exceptions.Timeout:
    time.sleep((2**attempt) + random.random())
```
sam-ops: I'll add Go equivalent with context + backoff and note idempotency.
eli-docs: Add line: 'Only retry idempotent ops or use idempotency keys.'
devex-bot: PR template reminder: add changelog line and run smoke tests.
maria: Running the Py timeout example now for exact error text.
(5m) maria: Exact error: "requests.exceptions.ReadTimeout: HTTPSConnectionPool(host='api.redwood.ai', port=443): Read timed out." I'll include verbatim in troubleshooting table.
nina: Old gist: gist.github.com/old-embed-42 -> replace with https://github.com/redwood/embeddings#best-practices.

maria: lgtm after CI.
